name: Conversation browser
description: A browser on the conversation's Host that the agent drives with `demi browser` and the user watches in the work panel.

tree.name: browser
tree.summary: Operate the conversation’s persistent browser tabs on the Host running this shell. Use inspect to obtain node references; never guess them.

subcommands.name: open
subcommands.summary: Open a URL in a new tab on this Host; starts the conversation’s browser when needed.
subcommands.successOutput: readable page results; one validated JSON value with --json
subcommands.failureOutput: a browser error on stderr with nonzero exit status; an action is never replayed automatically

input.description: `open`: opens a tab at a URL, starting the browser when it does not run.

load.description: How far a navigation loads before it answers.

timeout.description: Whole operation deadline in milliseconds; default 300000, maximum 300000.

input.title: OpenInput

json.description:
What `open` answers: the new tab, with its title and viewport when the
page reported them in time.

tab.description:
A tab's public identity, which `open` and `tabs` return: `t` and the
tab's number in the conversation (`browser.md` § One tab registry).

mode.description:
Who decides a tab's viewport (`live-view.md` § Modes): the user's
panel, a phone, or the agent.

viewport.description:
A tab's viewport (`live-view.md` § Modes): its CSS size, the pixel ratio
it renders at, and who decides them.

json.title: OpenResult

subcommands.name: tabs

subcommands.failureOutput: a browser error on stderr with nonzero exit status; an action is never replayed automatically

input.title: TabsInput

items.description: A tab as `tabs` lists it and the conversation browser's tab methods return it.

id.description:
A tab's public identity, which `open` and `tabs` return: `t` and the
tab's number in the conversation (`browser.md` § One tab registry).

createdBy.description:
Who opened a tab: an agent, a page's `window.open`, a temporary command
such as `content.fetch`, or the user.

oneOf.description: An agent, by its number in the conversation.

opener.description:

tab's number in the conversation (`browser.md` § One tab registry).

oneOf.description: A temporary command of the agent with this number.

loading.description: Whether the browser loads the tab's top-level page.
